description:
Alerts You whenever a thing is copied to the clipboard


it's been like what, 8 months since the last release? Sorry! but i had to deal with translations not coming but since they can't work with it, it feels like release time...
What's been added:
- A Options UI that allows you to change those via a little window instead of touching the options.ini file, accessible via Edit Program's Settings --> Options
- An new option that hides your toast to be shown in screen recorders or screen capturing (when possible) for Windows 10 2020 (19041) users
- An entire Password Vault fully local on your machine whose job is to simply protect your passwords by changing it from "Hello" --> "****", hide it from captures and recordings and try to protect it from being stolen (BETA so it can be buggy) yay!!!!!
- Little and fun secrets somewhere :3
- Updates are now faster, i guess? as you can optionally add a UPDATE_SERVER_URL in your .env for updates!!!!!!
What Changed:
- Rework of translations (Which you can translate on Crowdin)
